description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Agency (Private) Limited (SLFEA) and the Enterprise United Co-operative (ECU), Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Discussions have been held between Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Agency (Private) Limited, a subsidiary of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment, and Enterprise United Co-operative falling under the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare of Japan, with regard to conducting a collaborative programme with the aim of providing internationally recognized technical and vocational training combined with education in technical subjects, Japanese language and culture to talented Sri Lankan youth with a view to increasing employment opportunities in Japan through safe, orderly and regular pathways and addressing skill shortages in Japan. A consensus has been reached to conduct the relevant training programme at the Sapugaskanda National Youth Services Council Training Centre in collaboration with the National Youth Services Council. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Agency (Private) Limited and the Enterprise United Cooperative of Japan for the relevant purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.
